signs.aries: Your relationships run hot and are openly contested; they start suddenly, and the arguments in them are frequent, loud and quickly forgotten.
signs.taurus: Your relationships take years to form and outlast everyone's expectations, including your own; the risk is staying long after it stopped working.
signs.gemini: Your relationships live on talk and go quiet when the talk stops; you may pair up more than once, and variety matters more to you than permanence.
signs.cancer: Your relationships turn domestic quickly; they run on care and on unspoken need, and neither of you says outright when something is wrong.
signs.leo: Your relationships are conducted in public and generously; there is warmth in them and there is also a contest over who gets to shine.
signs.virgo: Your relationships are working partnerships built on usefulness; the danger is that care turns into correction and affection into a list of faults.
signs.libra: Your relationships are the centre of your life and carefully kept in balance; the cost is how much goes unsaid to preserve that balance.
signs.scorpio: Your relationships are few, intense and transformative; loyalty in them is absolute, and so is the damage when trust goes.
signs.sagittarius: Your relationships need air and travel well; they falter when they become routine, and often bridge two countries or two worlds.
signs.capricorn: Your relationships are undertaken seriously and built like an institution; commitment comes as duty first and warmth after.
signs.aquarius: Your relationships are unconventional in shape and negotiated as equals; both of you keep a private territory that the other does not enter.
signs.pisces: Your relationships are compassionate and boundaryless; you end up rescuing or being rescued, and it takes years to see the person clearly.
